reason: A rule-enforcement and workflow-guard plugin that parses AGENTS.md, checks tool and text operations, controls selected changes, and records audit evidence.

summaries.zh: 从 AGENTS.md 解析用户规则，在工具操作和任务执行过程中进行守卫、授权控制与审计记录。
summaries.en: Parses user rules from AGENTS.md to guard selected tool operations, manage authorizations, and record execution audits.

capabilities: Guards and blocks selected file and tool-changing operations
Audits rule activations, authorizations, and command-output anomalies
Maintains temporary unlock, bypass, and authorization state
Writes audit logs and rule-understanding data
May invoke an LLM for low-confidence rule interpretation
